title: JSON and YAML — Final Assessment Blueprint
attempts: Platform-controlled; do not infer or hardcode attempts in course content.
question_selection: Use reviewed question pools and keep answer keys in protected course content. Backend authorization/redaction remains authoritative.
outcomes: Explain JSON and YAML structure and distinguish syntax from runtime interpretation.
Model common data and API payloads and validate JSON with an appropriate JSON Schema dialect.
Write YAML with correct indentation and scalar semantics and inspect parser compatibility.
Convert and compare formats while documenting data and presentation loss.
Apply secure parsing, input bounds, test fixtures, review, and production workflow practices.
remediation: Review the relevant lesson, retry its knowledge check, and add a targeted valid/invalid fixture before retaking an assessment. Passing a local blueprint file does not issue a certificate; certification must rely on a backend-verified result.
version_notes: Questions remain draft until technical review and test execution with named implementations. Standards and product syntax change; check linked official documentation before publication.
